'''Steven Horton''' (also published as '''Steve Horton''') posted about his first Star Wars CCG tournament on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in October 1997.<ref name="list-22749">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/22749.html? swccg-discussion message #22749], [[Steven Horton]] (1 October 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108114118/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/22749.html? Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 52nd at the [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d1814" /> and played [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS]] at the [[February 2002 Lafayette tournament]] in Lafayette, Indiana.<ref name="tr-d3404" />
